notes: Adjudication against the second extraction (2026-10-17), every disputed fact re-read in the cached store page and wiki pages: thermal.max_nozzle_temp stays the wiki's A Series Nozzle value 300 ℃ at official_page with its conflict note; the store page's 320 ℃ (the second extraction's value) is the deterministic row the merge keeps, so the disagreement is recorded, not hidden (owner to decide). The wiki layer-height ranges stay unverified (general guidance for every nozzle of that diameter, "Typically …"). The Filament Compatibility table stays as per-cell relations (§C.6: hotend matrix tables are text plus curated relations; target_kind material, since no compat-targets label maps these names and B.2 has no 'product' target kind), not as supported/unsupported spec lists. extrusion.filament_diameter and motion.max_flow are not listed as not_published: the A1, A1 mini and A2L printer pages publish "Filament Diameter 1.75 mm" and "Max Flow for Hotend (Standard Flow Hotend) 40 mm³/s", so "not published by the manufacturer" would be untrue; neither is stored as a value either, since this product's own sources do not state them.
